steps: Note symptoms: multiple drains backing up, gurgling toilets.
Locate the sewer cleanout (usually a capped pipe near the foundation).
A pro feeds a motorized auger through the cleanout to the main line.
Ask about a camera inspection to identify root intrusion or pipe damage.
Consider annual preventive snaking if you have mature trees near the line.
